title: POST /v1/trial-calls/route request body (as-built)
description: Derived from TelephonyApp.route_trial_inbound_call / _complete_trial_inbound_call (src/telephony_ai/app.py:8280, 8656). 'pin' is required and must match a trial call in status ready/ringing/media_started. live_media defaults to false; when false the call is simulated (media_started) and demo artifacts are generated.

live_media.description: Alias: live. Live media is gated by OPENPHONEX_LIVE_CALLS_ENABLED / OPENPHONEX_VOICE_LIVE_ENABLED (+ REALTIME_LIVE_ENABLED for realtime).

media_pipeline.description: Aliases accepted by _requested_media_pipeline; realtime_media/low_latency_realtime booleans also force realtime.
